author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Calculate working space before a PS2 library migration
summary: Measure source bytes, destination free bytes, largest-file limits, temporary verification space, and safety margin before copying; verify in batches so a full destination cannot produce silent truncation.
heroAlt: macOS Disk Utility image parameters screen showing destination and format choices before a large disc-image operation

blocks.text: Budget for source, destination, and proof

A migration needs more than the displayed library total. The destination must hold the files, filesystem overhead, any cue/bin companions, and enough free space for Android and the storage provider to operate normally. Verification reports and a retained source copy also occupy space elsewhere. Calculate exact bytes from a recursive inventory rather than adding rounded gigabyte labels.
Do not begin when the plan requires deleting the source halfway through to finish the destination. That removes the only rollback before the copy has been proven.

items: Exact byte total and file count for every planned source root.
Largest individual file size and destination filesystem limit.
Destination free bytes measured immediately before the copy.
A safety margin for filesystem overhead and normal Android operation.
Separate space for hash reports, logs, and the retained source.

blocks.text: Approve migration batches against remaining capacity

items: 1. Generate a sorted inventory containing relative path, bytes, and SHA-256.
2. Subtract excluded archives, backups, and quarantined files that should never enter the active root.
3. Compare the largest image with the destination's maximum single-file size.
4. Set a stop threshold above zero free bytes; use the device's storage guidance and leave practical operating headroom.
5. Divide the inventory into batches whose total remains below available space after the threshold.
6. Copy the first batch without moving source files, then verify counts, bytes, and hashes.
7. Re-measure destination free space instead of assuming the predicted value.
8. Continue only while measured remaining space supports the next batch plus margin.

blocks.text: Sparse allocation, provider caches, trash folders, and reserved filesystem blocks can make file-manager totals differ from simple arithmetic. The measured post-batch result corrects the worksheet. If compression is used only for backup, its size must not be substituted for the extracted playable requirement.
The completed destination must have both a matching inventory and enough remaining capacity for stable operation.

items: Destination file count and total bytes match the approved inventory.
Every destination hash matches its source record.
Largest files crossed no filesystem boundary or truncation.
Remaining free space stays above the planned stop threshold after remount.
Two titles from the final batch cold-boot before the source is retired.
Copy reports success but bytes differ: treat the destination as incomplete.
Free space falls faster than predicted: inspect trash, provider cache, and hidden filesystem overhead.
One large file fails while smaller files copy: check single-file limit.
Android slows or other apps fail near capacity: stop and restore operating headroom.

blocks.text: Remove only the last incomplete batch

Using the worksheet's explicit destination paths, delete or quarantine only files from the failed batch, re-measure space, and keep all source data. Remove the incomplete folder grant from EmuCoreX so a partial set cannot collect profiles or saves.
Advertised capacity is not usable capacity
Storage vendors use decimal units, operating systems may display binary units, and filesystems reserve metadata space. Record bytes for calculations and human-readable units only as labels.
